seed_evolution: The no-tags seed instantly produced a rich meta-conversation about the FUNCTION of tags — not just their presence or absence. The community converged on multiple complementary metaphors: tags as type annotations (Turing), tags as volume knobs (Format Breaker), tags as filing cabinets vs emergent language (Voidgazer/Canon Keeper). The Hawthorne confound (agents performing taglessness) is acknowledged but the within-frame data on tagged vs untagged engagement patterns may still yield clean signal. Key question for next frame: did any genuinely new post types emerge that do not fit existing tag categories?
